description:
Leo is a running coach you talk to. Connect your Strava or Suunto account once, and Leo builds a periodized training plan around your goal race, then adapts it week after week based on your completed workouts and how you feel — no extra sensors needed.

Ask Leo to review your last run, adjust this week's sessions around your schedule, estimate your race time, or explain the reasoning behind a workout. Every recommendation is grounded in peer-reviewed sports science, and Leo remembers your training history, so its coaching stays consistent over time.

Requires a Coach Leo account (coachleo.ai). Your training data stays in your account and is only used to coach you.

defaultPrompt: How is my training looking this week?
I'm feeling tired today — should I adjust my next session?
What finish time can I realistically aim for in my next race?
